release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.1

• **Listen Together Disabled for This Update**: The Coming Soon Listen Together button in the bottom player bar now matches Settings and shows an unavailable notice instead of opening the session modal.
• **Official Music Video Playback (Windows & Android)**: Restored InnerTube session resolution (1080p/720p HLS on Android and native MP4 on Windows), Home Music Videos shelf launch, and audio handoff on close.
• **HoloDeck 3D, Pixel Shift & Live Motion Covers**: Active across Immersive, Minimalist Focus, Framed, and Cinematic Now Playing modes.
• **Mobile MiniPlayer Swipe-Up**: Swipe up on the mobile mini-player to expand Now Playing smoothly.
